`requirements.txt` is a manifest, not a pip file. Each line is a
filename and a URL. The files land in `models/` at the checkout root.

Blank lines and comments are skipped. A line that is not two tokens is
an error, which is what we want from a hand-edited manifest.

``` python
from fastcore.test import test_eq

names = [name for name, _ in _entries()]
test_eq(names, ["medium_det.onnx", "medium_rec.onnx", "ppocrv6_dict.txt"])
names
```
